comparison.thinking_mode: disabled for agent, customer, reviewer, and evaluator

outcome.diagnosis: On the first identity-lookup tool action, the agent emitted explanatory text and a find_user_id_by_email tool call in the same assistant message. The pinned tau-bench half-duplex validator rejects this message format and the run terminated with agent_error before the customer was authenticated.
outcome.review_note: The native reviewer summary said no errors had occurred so far, but it did not account for the orchestration-level agent_error/protocol failure.
outcome.interpretation: Changing from V4 Flash to V4 Pro with thinking disabled did not remove the mixed text/tool-call behavior in this one episode. This does not establish a general comparison of model capability.

billing.note: LiteLLM reported that this model has no price mapping; the native cost field does not establish the amount billed by InferAI.
